Name: Village Gratitude
Author: ismael1508
Description:
Tired of starting each day with empty pockets?
This mod rewards you with gold every morning as a token of appreciation for your efforts in Pelican Town.
💰 By default, you'll receive [b]1000g[/b] each day when you wake up.
💡 You can customize this amount easily via the config.json file to suit your preferred gameplay style — whether you're looking for a small boost or a major head start.
😉 No complex menus, no requirements, no fuss. Just wake up and get paid!

[b]New Gratitude System:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]How it works:[/b] You can now choose to show your appreciation to the village either every day or once a month.
[*][b]How to configure:[/b] Simply open the [b]config.json[/b] file and set the gratitude frequency to [b]"Daily"[/b] or [b]"Monthly"[/b] according to your preference.
[/list]

📥 Installation Instructions[list=1]
[*]✅ [b]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][/b] – required for all Stardew Valley mods
[*]📦 Download and extract this mod
[*][b]📂[/b] Move the [b]DailyMoneyMod[/b] folder into your [b]Mods [/b]folder:
[*][b]🛠️ (Optional) [/b]After launching the game once, a [b]config.json[/b] file will appear inside the mod's folder. You can edit the [b]DailyAmount[/b] value to change how much gold you receive each day.

[/list]
